mapper.update: UPDATE `kkirikkiri`.`stores` SET `approval_status` = #{status}, `approved_at` = IF(#{status} = 'APPROVED', NOW(), NULL) WHERE `email` = #{email}
UPDATE `kkirikkiri`.`users` SET `status` = 'DORMANT' WHERE `last_login_at` < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND `status` NOT IN ('ADMIN', 'BLACK', 'DORMANT')
mapper.select: SELECT u.`name` AS `ownerName`, s.`email` AS `email`, s.`store_name` AS `storeName`, s.`business_number` AS `businessNumber`, s.`approval_status` AS `approvalStatus`, s.`license_url` AS `licenseUrl`, s.`report_card_url` AS `reportCardUrl`, s.`applied_at` AS `appliedAt` FROM `kkirikkiri`.`users` AS `u` JOIN `kkirikkiri`.`stores` AS `s` ON u.`email` = s.`email` WHERE s.`approval_status` = 'PENDING' OR u.`status` = 'PENDING_BOSS' ORDER BY s.`applied_at` DESC

SELECT `email` AS `email`, `name` AS `name`, `nickname` AS `nickname`, `contact` AS `contact`, `is_admin` AS `isAdmin`, `is_boss` AS `isBoss`, `status` AS `status`, `social_type_code` AS `socialTypeCode`, `created_at` AS `createdAt`, `last_login_at` AS `lastLoginAt`, (CASE WHEN (YEAR(NOW()) - YEAR(`birth`) + 1) >= 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `isAdult` FROM `kkirikkiri`.`users`
AND `nickname` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND `email` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND (`nickname` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR `email` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY `created_at` DESC
